name: phoenix-city
description: Phoenix City: a Claude Code agent marketplace built around Agent City — a city of agents that writes, tests, and ships your code to a GitHub pull request from a single command, rising from every failure until the checks burn green.

plugins.name: agent-city
plugins.description: Agent City: an orchestrated city of agents. The Mayor runs the pipeline; the executive agents do the work — city-engineer writes the code, city-inspector writes and runs the tests, city-herald keeps the README and docs in sync with what shipped, city-courier opens and stewards the GitHub pull request, city-archivist provisions a database when one is needed. The city-marshal (four deputies, halt authority) and the city-bank (advisory token budget) ride every phase. One command in, a passing pull request out. Never merges to main.
